name: CHUM AI-originated conversion attribution
purpose: Issue privacy-minimized referral tokens for legitimate AI-originated handoffs and distinguish discovery, landing, checkout, verified payment, and fulfillment without treating checkout as revenue.

stages.landing: A signed CHUM referral reached the destination.
stages.checkout_started: A user entered an approved checkout path. This is not payment.
stages.payment_verified: Trusted server-side/payment-provider evidence verified a payment. Public callers cannot assert this stage.
stages.fulfilled: Trusted evidence records fulfillment after verified payment.

revenue_rule: Only payment_verified events with authoritative payment verification may count toward verified revenue.
human_gate: Discovery and attribution create no payment obligation. Existing explicit human confirmation rules remain in force.
